claims.statement: The assurance kernel converts electromagnetic stress-energy at an oriented surface into outward four-momentum flux n_i T^{i nu}, with the time component independently checked against normal Poynting flux and the spatial components against negative conventional Maxwell traction.
nonclaims: A local boundary-flux identity is not a multidimensional kinetic plasma-wing force result.

claims.statement: Manufactured right- and left-moving plane-wave slabs close their field four-momentum through the appropriate outward boundary, while thousands of arbitrary fields reproduce Poynting and Maxwell-traction identities.
nonclaims: These bounded manufactured states are not a universal open-boundary convergence proof.

claims.statement: Relativistic particle crossings are classified as inward or outward by velocity relative to the declared surface normal and close in the same field-plus-matter four-momentum ledger; an untracked boundary impulse is rejected.
nonclaims: Discrete crossing bookkeeping does not model material-surface interactions, emission, or sheath physics.

claims.statement: Wire the open-boundary four-momentum contract into every timestep of a multidimensional electromagnetic kinetic solver and demonstrate convergence before promoting force or torque response surfaces.
required_evidence: grid, timestep, particle-count, shape-order, and domain refinement
